items.entity: Height of the load line on the free face
items.description: The load line is drawn approximately halfway up the free face, without a numerical height.
readings: Slightly above mid-height, approximately z = 0.52, following the sketch; for example, z = 33/64 on the stated grid.
items.evidence: Sec. 4.1 specifies loading on the face opposite the fixed face; Fig. 2(A) supplies the undimensioned vertical position.

items.description: No load intensity or total resultant is specified. Changing its common amplitude only scales compliance.
readings: Downward resultant P = 2, with the same spatial distribution.
